retrievalProfile.description: A centered portrait of a seated musician in a rustic barn setting with an acoustic guitar and wide-tracked serif typography at the top.

recipe.visualDefinition: A medium shot of a man with curly hair sitting cross-legged on hay in a dark barn, wearing a blue denim shirt and light jeans, with a 12-string acoustic guitar leaning beside him. The lighting is warm and directional, creating a soft glow against a dark, textured background of wood and hay.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject centered horizontally in the lower two-thirds of the frame
Acoustic guitar placed to the left of the subject as a secondary anchor
Typography positioned in the upper third, spanning the width of the subject's shoulders
Warm, earthy tones in the foreground contrasting with a dark, shadowed background
coreInvariants: The subject must be seated cross-legged on the ground.
An acoustic guitar must be present and leaning vertically.
The setting must be a rustic, dimly lit interior like a barn or shed.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The man is the central focus, occupying the middle and lower-middle ground at a medium scale.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The man's face and the bright body of the sunburst guitar act as dual anchors.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the bright typography at the top, moves down to the subject's face, then follows the guitar neck down to the floor.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant dark negative space in the upper corners and background to emphasize the subject.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep browns and shadows provide the atmospheric base.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Light blue denim and pale skin tones pop against the dark background.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Warm orange and yellow sunburst on the guitar body.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high value contrast between the subject and the dark barn interior.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Geometric serif with high horizontal expansion
letterConstructionRules: Uniform stroke weight with sharp, fine serifs
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'L' has a short horizontal base
The 'G' has a distinct inward-pointing spur

composition.relationshipToImage: separated by a thin horizontal rule

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A large, wide serif for the primary name paired with a tiny, extremely tracked sans-serif for the title, separated by a thin line.
graphicDevices: Thin horizontal rule separating name and title

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the wide, small-serif aesthetic and uppercase structure.
Captures the wide, clean geometric feel for the subtitle.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a photograph of a man with curly hair sitting cross-legged in a dark barn on hay, with a 12-string acoustic guitar leaning next to him. Use warm, low-key lighting.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the artist name in a wide, light serif font at the top center in light blue. Add a thin horizontal line below it, followed by the album title in a very small, widely spaced sans-serif font.

verificationChecks: Is the text centered at the top?
Is the guitar leaning on the left side of the frame?
Is there a thin line between the two text elements?

adjustableVariables: Density of hay in the foreground
mustRedesign: Do not use the specific artist's face; use a generic folk-style male model.
Do not use the exact brand logo on the guitar headstock.
postGenerationChecks: Check that the text is not touching the subject's head.
Ensure the guitar sunburst is warm and saturated.
Verify the tracking on the subtitle is significantly wider than the main title.
Confirm the background is dark enough to make the subject stand out.
recipe.reuseFormula: Rustic Portrait + Wide Serif Header + Acoustic Prop
